translations.web: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.
translations.bsb: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
translations.kjv: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
translations.asv: Vow, and pay unto Jehovah your God: Let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
